questions.q: Where does the author film the video?
questions.e: In the video: "iskoristiću još ovo malo što sam u domu pa da snimam videe odavde" — while she still lives in the dormitory, she films videos from there.

questions.q: What will the new series of videos be about?
questions.e: In the video: "da vidite kako se živi studentski život" — so that you can see what student life is like.

questions.q: What does the author sincerely recommend to everyone who has the chance?
questions.e: In the video: "moja iskrena preporuka za svakoga ko ima priliku jeste da ovde živi" — my sincere recommendation to everyone who has the chance is to live here.

questions.q: What does the author ask for at the end?
o: To write recommendations in the comments
questions.e: In the video: "ako imate neke preporuke, svakako možete da me pitate i da mi pišete u komentaru" — if you have any suggestions, feel free to write in the comments.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Evo, *iskoristiću* još ovo malo što sam u domu.
questions.e: Iskoristiti — to make use of, to use.

questions.q: I moja iskrena *preporuka* za svakoga ko ima priliku.
questions.e: Preporuka — recommendation, advice; from the verb preporučiti.
Rez — a cut, a "splice" in editing. Bez reza — without editing.

questions.q: Ako iko bude došao do *kraja* videa.
questions.e: Kraj — end. Do kraja — to the end.
The preposition u ("in") with a location requires the locative case: u sledećem videu — "in the next video".
After u in answer to "where?" — locative case: u komentaru — "in the comment".

questions.q: Da vidite kako se živi studentski ___.
questions.e: The object is inanimate, so the accusative coincides with the nominative: život.

questions.q: Svakome ko ima priliku preporučujem da ovde ___.
questions.e: After da a personal verb form is used: ko → he/she, hence živi.
